mostWorthwhile.text: Making a song from the cave's echo was the most worthwhile passage: reflected sound became a remembered, repeatable rhythm that could be taught.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing pigment in the cave was straightforward preparation, but less interesting than making and using it.

surprise.text: I expected the call might lead directly to a song; instead, it first produced an echo that memory turned into a rhythmic pattern.

arbitrary.text: Adding stars to the animal painting followed the goal clearly, but felt more like an instruction to decorate than a consequential combination.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter if it built on the creative and educational connections here; the echo-to-song sequence made me curious about what else the community might make.
